source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p = (y+dy, x+dx)
                    if 0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == 2 and p not in seen:
                        seen.add(p)
                        q.append(p)
            objects.append(cells)
    out = [[0]*6 for _ in range(3)]
    # Each T is reduced to a point. Its stem direction selects the point color;
    # coarse source position selects one of the separated output locations.
    for cells in objects:
        rows = [p[0] for p in cells]
        cols = [p[1] for p in cells]
        r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
        c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)
        counts = {}
        for y, x in cells:
            counts[y] = counts.get(y, 0) + 1
        bar_row = next((y for y,n in counts.items() if n >= 3), r0)
        color = 3 if bar_row > r0 else 1
        cy = sum(rows)/len(rows)
        cx = sum(cols)/len(cols)
        oy = 0 if cy < h/2 else 2
        ox = 0 if cx < w/2 else 3
        # Preserve distinct objects that land in the same coarse location.
        x = ox
        while out[oy][x] != 0:
            x += 2
            if x >= (3 if ox == 0 else 6):
                x = ox + (1 if ox == 0 else 1)
            if x >= 6 or out[oy][x] == 0:

        out[oy][x] = color
    return out
